digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified workflow dispatch-triggered jobs dominate the Actions pool, not tickets-branch pushes, causing runner starvation during patchset bursts.

Current full-route job graph per-dispatch costs 17–24 runner jobs with immediate 13-way fan-out; incident-period bursts reached 22 waiting jobs and 873s wait times; organization plan is Free with 20 total / 5 macOS concurrency limits.

Four mutually exclusive remediation directions are costed: bundle four Ubuntu preflights and cap mutation matrix (Option A, recommended), coalesce patchsets (Option B, low value), move macOS to scheduled health (Option C, weakens pre-merge), or upgrade plan (Option D, recurring cost).

Option A reduces immediate fan-out from 13 to 10 jobs and upper simultaneous demand from 19 to 12 with minimal latency impact and no workflow removal; three concurrent full routes would request 30 rather than 39 immediate jobs.
